title: Grammar of Anarchy (Final Assembly Address)
audioTranscript: If we wish to maintain democracy not merely in form, but also in fact, what must we do? The first thing in my judgment we must do is to hold fast to constitutional methods of achieving our social and economic objectives.

title: BBC Interview: On What Constitutes Democracy
audioTranscript: Democracy is not merely a form of government. It is primarily a mode of associated living, of conjoint communicated experience. It is essentially an attitude of respect and reverence towards one's fellow men.

title: All India Radio: On Fundamental Rights & Article 32
audioTranscript: Fundamental rights are meaningless unless there is an effective legal machinery to enforce them. That is why Article 32 stands as the very heart and soul of the Constitution.
